note.question: What determines deciding which patients to place into the various available care units at any time?
note.overview: Care units are the facilities where admitted hospital patients receive treatment and monitoring services. This paper studies the problem of deciding which patients to place into the various available care units at any time. To determine placements in practice, hospitals rely on clinicians to discern a patient’s care needs and appropriately trade-off between future demand and limited bed availability.
